newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GENBEL, WORLDWIDE IN ASSET MANAGEMENT DEAL.
newsitem.headline: GENBEL, WORLDWIDE IN ASSET MANAGEMENT DEAL.

text.p: South Africa's Genbel Group and Worldwide Africa said on Thursday they had linked up with a number of local investment professionals in a joint venture called Infinity Asset Management.
Guy Woolford, former chief investment officer at Syfrets, will be one of the investment professionals, the parties said.

"An experienced multicultural management team is being assembled by Woolford and his co-managing director Lwazi Koyana to compete for retirement fund mandates and also to establish retail investment funds," the parties said in a statement.
Worldwide will hold a 40 percent stake in Infinity with the balance split equally between management and Genbel.
Worldwide and Genbel will both have board representation together with management and outside directors.
